==Description==
The '''Zoomer''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] that only appeared in [[Area 51]] as part of the [[Area 51 Event]]. It was slightly faster than the [[Alien (Area 51)|Alien]] and [[Strong Alien]], with the same health as the latter. 

==Appearance==
The '''Zoomer''' had blonde hair and a white headband around its head. It had no eyes, had a drooling zombie face, wore orange wristbands and had green skin. Its torso was orange and its legs were dark orange. Its running animation was similar to the Naruto run.

==Strategy==
*If needed, you can use the [[Freezer]] or [[Pyromancer]] to slow '''Zoomers''' down.
*Low firerate towers, such as the [[Minigunner]], are very effective against '''Zoomers''', while high firerate towers, such as the [[Sniper]], will struggle against it.
*You can use the [[Demoman]] and [[Rocketeer|Rocketer]] to damage groups of '''Zoomers''', though you may need a [[Commander]] to lower their firerate.

==Trivia==
*The '''Zoomer''' was based on the main character from [[wp:Naruto|Naruto]].
**This itself was based on the ''Storm Area 51, They Can't Stop All of Us'' event where the Facebook event said: "''If we naruto run{{sic}}, we can move faster than their bullets.''"
***This sentence was somewhat imitated with the text at the start of wave 7.
**The running animation of the '''Zoomer''' was the Naruto run, another reference to ''Naruto''.
*The '''Zoomer''' is a reference to a nickname for Generation Z.
**The '''Zoomer''' being based on ''Naruto'' is a stereotype that younger people are fonder of anime.
